name: @jkudish/discern-mcp
description: MCP server for calibrated judgment tools: verify claims, screen for injection, find, rerank, classify, decide, compare passages, extract fields, review patches, and gate completion claims, each with typed probabilities. Runs on TypeSafe Jev by default or OpenAI's Decisions API.
author: Joey Kudish

scripts.test: node --test test/unit.test.mjs test/mock.test.mjs test/provider.test.mjs test/typesafe-abort-regression.test.mjs test/http.test.mjs test/exa-example.test.mjs test/server.test.mjs test/aliases.test.mjs test/compat.test.mjs test/hook-gate.test.mjs
